def pick(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> int:
    """Pick an element of the non-empty list xs, chosen deterministically from seed.

    The same xs and seed always give the same element. The index is seed
    modulo the length of xs, so seeds 0, 1, 2, ... walk through xs in order
    and then wrap around.
    """
    pre xs.len() > 0
    post out in xs
    ex pick([10, 20, 30], 0) == 10
    ex pick([10, 20, 30], 4) == 20
    ex pick([7], 12345) == 7
    n = xs.len()
    i = seed % n
    if i < 0:
        i += n
    return xs[i]
